top_signals.title: Ukraine strikes third Yandex data center, disrupting digital services across Russia
top_signals.summary: A third Yandex data center in Russia was hit by Ukrainian drones over the weekend, forcing it to shut down and causing further disruptions to cloud services, payments, deliveries and other online services across the country.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Strategists See Value in Duration After Bond Rout
top_signals.summary: After weeks of selling that pushed Treasury yields to multi-year highs, Wall Street strategists are starting to see value in bonds again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump's Grid Security Order Could Backfire on America's AI Boom
top_signals.summary: A White House executive order designed to secure the US power grid from Chinese-made equipment is more likely to disrupt battery storage supply chains than the transformers and switchgear it aims to target, according to new Rystad Energy analysis. Executive Order 14421, signed by President Donald Trump on 26 August 2026, names substation transformers, grid-connected inverters, battery energy storage systems, high-voltage circuit breakers and generation turbines as covered equipment. top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
